name: BIND-REJECT: a real-profile parity run with twin bindings still on — must fail at setup naming the bound calibration keys
notes: SG-001: 'flag or reject unapproved binding substitutions'. Bindings supply tagTracking.shotRangeIn / powerTable / launchAngle* / exitHeightIn from the twin's solver; with bindingsPolicy reject that is a setup failure naming those keys (expected here), so a synthetic calibration can never pass as a real-profile result. Geometry bindings (wheel size, camera mount) are allowed; reject-all refuses those too. Fails by design.
